verdict.rationale: Issuing scoped API credentials is a fair question for a government e-services provider with system-to-system filing channels, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no API keys, tokens, or least-privilege credentials an agent could use. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: EFILE uses a single number-and-password login for certified software, and 'authorize access' / Represent a Client covers delegating access to human representatives.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
